prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: key pose for a multi-frame fortune-reading loader animation
Input images: Image 1 is the approved character identity and material reference
Primary request: create the same Little Oracle mascot in a distinctly different active posture for a loading screen—the character floats upright with its single eye fully open and completely unobstructed, looking directly forward, while both small hands hover apart around a tiny glowing lavender fortune orb as if gently reading the user’s fate
Subject: preserve the same pastel-lavender pointed hood, deep-violet inner hood, single cosmic violet-blue iris, warm-gold hood stars and dangling star charm; cute rounded body; the full circular eye and iris must be clearly visible with no eyelid covering any part of it
Style/medium: premium handmade soft 3D polymer-clay model; matte, rounded, subtle fingerprints and sculpting irregularities; collectible designer-toy finish; identical visual family to Image 1
Composition/framing: one centered full-body character, floating pose, hands separated symmetrically around the orb, compact silhouette, straight-on view, generous clear space on all sides; no cropping
Lighting/mood: bright diffused studio daylight with soft lavender bounce; gentle magical glow emitted only by the small orb; sweet, focused, reassuring, never spooky
Color palette: light lilac, dusty orchid, deep violet, indigo-violet iris, champagne-gold accents; designed for warm ivory and blush-lavender light-theme screens
Scene/backdrop: perfectly uniform flat chroma-key green (#00FF00), edge to edge, for clean post-production cutout
Constraints: same character identity and proportions as Image 1; exactly one large eye; eye fully open and unobstructed; exactly two hands; one small orb only; no scenery; no text; no symbols inside the orb; no watermark; no cast shadow; no background texture, pattern, gradient, or green reflection on the character
Avoid: closed or half-closed eyelid, hands clasped together, seated posture, dark background, horror, occult menace, glossy vinyl, flat illustration, extra eyes, extra limbs, busy sparkles
